name: direction
title: Direction
description: Sets the reading direction for Radix components below it, so menus, selects and sliders mirror correctly in right to left layouts.
notes: The provider only tells Radix components the direction. Also set the dir attribute on the html element or a wrapper so text, flex order and logical utilities like ps-* and start-* flip.
useDirection returns the current direction, handy for flipping icons such as arrows.
